name: @alexiocode/node-red-contrib-meross-cloud-devices
description: A module for Node-RED that allows to retreive information from our online Meross devices (using Meross Cloud) and control them. It includes nodes for Smart Plugs, Smart Switches, Smart Hubs, Smart Presence Sensors and Smart Garage Door Openers. It is based on the "node-red-contrib-meross-cloud" Node-RED module, from @kronsi.
author: Alejandro Pedro Alonso-Basurto Díaz
